competency_results.qualification: Explicit unavailable roles are reported here. Schema validation identifies absent required fields; the supplied legacy gap audit is a separate documented assessment.

queries.claim_statement: Grouped adaptive loss weighting reduced final-network relative L2 retention error over the fitted interval compared with fixed coefficients in all ten paired Allen--Cahn seeds; both arms retained the same positive rate-normalised RK4 term.
queries.direction: grouped_rate1 minus fixed_rate1 is negative for final-network fitted-interval retention error; both arms use positive rate-normalised RK4

queries.claim_statement: The confirmatory data did not demonstrate a grouped-over-fixed error reduction on direct validation, direct test, numerical-continuation test or terminal-state evaluation.
queries.direction: two-sided 95 percent paired t intervals include zero on all four held-out or terminal criteria

queries.claim_statement: The three-seed development study did not show growing support for a grouped-over-fixed final-network fitted-interval retention advantage as the number of temporal blocks increased.
queries.direction: fitted-interval retention-error difference slope is non-negative across 4, 8 and 12 blocks

queries.claim_statement: The grouped controller maintained its configured within-group coefficient budgets while allocating a majority of the active later-block constraint budget to replay, with no recorded guard triggers.
queries.direction: budget discrepancies are at floating-point scale, guard count is zero, and median later-block replay share exceeds one half
